description: This PHP class 'stashrestInterface' extends 'codeTrackerInterface' and provides methods to connect and interact with a Bitbucket Server (Stash) REST API, including project, repository, branch, commit, and content retrieval, with configuration handling and URL generation.

classes.name: stashrestInterface
classes.description: A class for interfacing with Bitbucket Server (Stash) via REST API, handling configuration, connection, and data retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets configuration, and establishes connection.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration with default URLs if missing.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client instance.

methods.name: getEnterCodeURL
methods.description: Returns URL for entering code links.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the Bitbucket Server API.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves project details by project key.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves list of projects.

methods.name: getProjectsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns projects formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getRepos
methods.description: Retrieves repositories for a project.

methods.name: getReposForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns repositories formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getRepoContent
methods.description: Retrieves repository content at a specified path.

methods.name: getRepoContentForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns repository content for HTML select input.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Retrieves branches for a repository.

methods.name: getBranchesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns branches formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getCommits
methods.description: Retrieves commits for a branch.

methods.name: getCommitsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns commits formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: objectAttrToKeyName
methods.description: Converts attribute set to key-name mapping.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDName
methods.description: Converts attribute set to ID-name mapping.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDNameKey
methods.description: Converts attribute set to ID-name with key mapping.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuration XML.

methods.name: checkCfg
methods.description: Validates configuration parameters.
